title: 11th Sitting of first session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/1/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 5/1/2026 to 7/1/2026).

Question from Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to Minister of Islamic Affairs and Endowments Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: on exactly what date will the list of people selected to perform Hajj that year, who have paid, be published?
First reading of the Bill to amend the Prevention of Sexual Abuse and Harassment Act (Law No. 16/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Kelaa MP Abdulla Shareef.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the Bill to amend the Maldives Fisheries Act (Law No. 14/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo South MP Mohamed Alsan Ahmed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to question the Islamic Minister on the Hajj list, introduce a Sexual Abuse and Harassment Act amendment, open debate on an Employment Act amendment, and continue the Fisheries Act amendment.
